name: Strawberry Panzanella (Italian Bread Salad) with Tofu, Feta & Mint
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice tofu. Place in a large bowl, then sprinkle with cornstarch and spices. Gently toss to coat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and pan-fry, turning occasionally, until browned and crispy, 5-7 minutes. Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Place in a clean large bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and quarter strawberries. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl and set aside. (Reserve remaining mint for serving.)
Cut or tear bread into bite-sized pieces.
Return skillet to low heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread and cook, stirring occasionally, until croutons are golden and toasted, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Add croutons to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide panzanella salad between plates; top with tofu, feta, and reserved mint. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
